headline: Let's get in touch!
body: Thank you for your interest in getting in touch with me! I welcome feedback, questions and new ideas — whether it's about one of my projects, a collaboration, or just to say hi. The fastest way to reach me is by email at [luizcouto@dcc.ufmg.br](mailto:luizcouto@dcc.ufmg.br) — I make an effort to respond to all messages quickly, although it may take me a bit longer during busy periods. If you prefer, you can also connect with me on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/luiz-felipe-couto/) or check out what I'm building on [GitHub](https://github.com/luiz-couto). I look forward to hearing from you!
